name: nice-insights
description: Nice Insights skills and connectors for ecommerce and financial metrics

plugins.name: nice-insights-metrics
plugins.description: Query Nice Insights ecommerce metrics: ad spend, sales, orders, margins, CAC, retention/LTV, inventory, checkout funnel, and email activity.

plugins.name: nice-insights-financials
plugins.description: Query and compare scenario-safe monthly financial statement and account hierarchy metrics. Requires the FinancialsAccess group and read:financials scope.
